# Generated by ppc worldbuilder: vanilla file patched so fleets sent over the open sea never target a river channel; do not edit by hand.
pacific_crossing_expedition = {

	unique = yes
	repeatable = no
	dynamic_first_waypoint = yes
	origin = none
	travel_mode = sea
	travel_speed = 0.9
	should_end_at_last_waypoint = no
	show_start_message = no

	variables = {
		provisions = {
			display = piechart
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/unit_view/food.dds"
			start = 100
			min = 0
			max = 100
			change_format = "VARIABLE_CHANGE_FORMAT"
			monthly_change = {
				subtract = {
					desc = "EXPEDITION_PROVISIONS_TRAVEL_DRAIN"
					value = 0
					if = {
						limit = {
							expedition_is_traveling = yes
						}
						add = 2
					}
				}
			}
		}
		morale = {
			display = piechart
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/flat_icons/navy_morale.dds"
			start = 100
			min = 0
			max = 100
			change_format = "VARIABLE_CHANGE_FORMAT"
			monthly_change = {
				subtract = {
					desc = "EXPEDITION_MORALE_LOW_PROVISIONS"
					value = 0
					if = {
						limit = {
							expedition_is_traveling = yes
							var:provisions < 50
						}
						add = 5
					}
				}
			}
		}
		num_ships = {
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/control_groups/navy.dds"
			start = 5
			min = 0
			max = 6
		}
		cargo = {
			icon = "gfx/interface/icons/trade_goods/icon_goods_cloves.dds"
			start = 0
			min = 0
		}
	}

	potential = {
		discovered_any_in_americas_trigger = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = tornaviaje_discovered }
		has_presence_in = scripted_geography:pacific_coast_americas_geography
	}

	can_start = {
		has_advance = open_sea_exploration
		any_owned_location = {
			is_port = yes pp_is_sea_coast = yes
			top_owner ?= root
			is_in_scripted_geography = scripted_geography:pacific_coast_americas_geography
		}
	}

	leader = {
		is_explorer = yes
		is_expedition_leader = no
		has_exploration = no
	}

	on_start = {
		scope:expedition = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = expedition_leader }
				remove_commander = expedition_leader
			}
		}
		ordered_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				is_port = yes pp_is_sea_coast = yes
				top_owner ?= root
				is_in_scripted_geography = scripted_geography:pacific_coast_americas_geography
			}
			order_by = {
				value = modifier:harbor_suitability
				multiply = -1
			}
			max = 1
			save_scope_as = pacific_departure_port
		}
		scope:expedition = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = scope:pacific_departure_port }
				set_variable = { name = departure_port value = scope:pacific_departure_port }
				add_new_waypoint = scope:pacific_departure_port
			}
			add_new_waypoint = location:pago_bay
			add_new_waypoint = location:samar_sea
			add_new_waypoint = location:dadinga_bay
		}
		trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.1
	}

	on_monthly = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					var:num_ships <= 0
					NOT = { has_variable = pacific_lost_fired }
				}
			}
			trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.17
		}
		scope:expedition = {
			remove_variable = pacific_monthly_event_claimed
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					expedition_is_traveling = yes
					var:morale < 50
					NOT = { has_variable = pacific_mutiny_cooldown }
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = 50
					subtract = scope:expedition.var:morale
					min = 1
				}
				scope:expedition = { set_variable = pacific_monthly_event_claimed }
				trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.18
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					expedition_is_traveling = yes
					var:provisions < 55
					NOT = { has_variable = pacific_monthly_event_claimed }
					NOT = { has_variable = pacific_scurvy_done }
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = 55
					subtract = scope:expedition.var:provisions
					min = 2
				}
				scope:expedition = { set_variable = pacific_monthly_event_claimed }
				trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.3
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					expedition_is_traveling = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = pacific_monthly_event_claimed }
				}
			}
			random_list = {
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = pacific_becalmed_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.7
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = pacific_storm_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.10
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = pacific_leak_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.11
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = spoiled_stores_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.13
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = { scope:expedition = { NOT = { has_variable = fish_shoal_done } } }
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.12
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = {
						scope:expedition = {
							has_variable = tornaviaje_south_route
							NOT = { has_variable = south_island_done }
						}
					}
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.20
				}
				1 = {
					trigger = {
						scope:expedition = {
							has_variable = tornaviaje_homeward
							var:morale < 50
							NOT = { has_variable = turn_back_cooldown }
						}
					}
					trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.22
				}
				7 = {}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = {
					expedition_is_traveling = yes
					has_variable = tornaviaje_homeward
					has_variable = pacific_pleas_ignored
					var:morale < 60
					NOT = { has_variable = pacific_monthly_event_claimed }
					NOT = { has_variable = pacific_defiance_cooldown }
				}
			}
			random = {
				chance = {
					value = 45
					subtract = scope:expedition.var:morale
					min = 5
				}
				scope:expedition = { set_variable = pacific_monthly_event_claimed }
				random_list = {
					2 = {
						trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.23
					}
					1 = {
						trigger = { scope:expedition = { var:num_ships > 1 } }
						trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.24
					}
					1 = {
						trigger = { scope:expedition = { var:num_ships > 1 } }
						trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.25
					}
					2 = {
						trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.26
					}
					2 = {
						trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.27
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_new_location = {
		scope:location = {
			discover_location = root
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:north_pacific_coast }
			location:revillagigedo_islands = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea1 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea2 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea3 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea4 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea5 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea6 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea7 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea8 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea9 = { discover_location = root }
			location:revillagigedo_high_sea10 = { discover_location = root }
		}
	}

	on_arrive_to_waypoint = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:pago_bay }
			trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.2
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:samar_sea }
			trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.4
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:dadinga_bay }
			trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.5
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:guahan_coast }
			trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.19
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:pacific_north_equatorial_current20 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.21
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { scope:location = location:mendocino_cape }
			trigger_event_non_silently = pacific_crossing_events.9
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:expedition = { has_variable = tornaviaje_returning }
				scope:location = scope:expedition.var:departure_port
			}
			end_expedition = scope:expedition
		}
	}

	on_end = {
		if = {
			limit = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = tornaviaje_returning } }
			set_variable = manila_galleon_route_established
			if = {
				limit = { scope:expedition = { has_variable = tornaviaje_south_route } }
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = southern_return_route
					days = 10950
				}
			}
			else = {
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = manila_galleon_route
					days = 10950
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = tornaviaje_discovered } }
				set_global_variable = { name = tornaviaje_discovered value = 1 }
				add_prestige = prestige_radical_bonus
				add_legitimacy = legitimacy_severe_bonus
			}
			else = {
				add_prestige = prestige_severe_bonus
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:expedition = { var:cargo > 0 } }
				add_gold = {
					value = scope:expedition.var:cargo
					multiply = "capital.market.market_price(goods:cloves)"
				}
				capital.market = {
					add_goods_supply = {
						amount = scope:expedition.var:cargo
						goods = goods:cloves
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:expedition = { var:morale >= 60 } }
				custom_tooltip = pacific_crossing_expedition_high_morale_prestige_tt
				add_prestige = prestige_weak_bonus
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:expedition = { var:morale < 25 } }
				custom_tooltip = pacific_crossing_expedition_low_morale_prestige_tt
				add_prestige = prestige_weak_penalty
			}
		}
	}

	ai_chance_to_check = {
		value = define:NAI|EXPEDITION_DEFAULT_CHANCE_TO_CHECK
		multiply = 0.5
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					AND = {
						has_ruler = yes
						ruler = { 
							has_trait = expansionist 
						}
					}
					AND = {
						has_societal_value = societal_value_type:land_vs_naval
						societal_value:land_vs_naval > 0
					}
				}
			}
			multiply = 4
		}
	}

	utility = {
		value = 16
	}

	leader_utility = {
		value = 1
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = navigator }
			add = 4
		}
	}
}
